display_fil:
Bumabaha sa tabing-ilog ng Maligaya.
May pamilyang hirap lumikas.
Hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan bilang silungan.
display_en:
Riverside homes in Maligaya flood.
One household needs help to evacuate.
The school shelter is not confirmed.
narration_fil: Sa kathang-isip na Barangay Maligaya, bumabaha sa tabing-ilog; may pamilyang hirap lumikas at may mataas na paaralang maaaring silungan ngunit hindi pa kumpirmado.
narration_en: In fictional Barangay Maligaya, riverside homes flood; one household needs evacuation help and a school may serve as shelter but has not been confirmed.

narration_fil: Markahan sa map ang baha, mga taong maaaring mangailangan ng tulong, at mga posibleng ruta at yaman. Itala ang hindi pa tiyak. Ipasuri sa lokal na DRRM office at health team ang mapa bago gamitin.
narration_en: Mark the flood hazard, people who may need help, and possible routes and resources. Record uncertainties. Ask the local DRRM office and health team to verify the map before use.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Sa mapa ng Maligaya, ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: On the Maligaya map, what do you do first?

options.fil: Markahan ang paaralan bilang silungan dahil ginamit ito noong nakaraan.
options.en: Mark the school as the shelter because it was used last time.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang hazard, suporta at kapasidad; ipa-verify ang ruta at shelter.
options.en: Separate hazard, support need and capacity; verify route and shelter.

options.fil: Isulat sa mapa ang pangalan at bahay ng pamilya para madali silang mahanap.
options.en: Write the family's name and house on the map so responders can find them.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan; markahan itong "kailangang kumpirmahin" hanggang masuri. 2: Sa hiwalay na tatlong layer, kita ang alam na at ang kailangan pang suriin. 3: Pangangailangan ang nasa mapa, hindi pangalan; igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
check.feedback_en: 1: The school is not confirmed; mark it "verify locally" until it is checked. 2: Keeping the three layers apart shows what is known and what still needs checking. 3: The map shows the need, not the name; protect household privacy.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Tatlong layer: panganib, pangangailangan, kakayahan.
Paaralan: "kailangang kumpirmahin".
Walang lokasyon ng residente sa mapa.
display_en:
Three layers: hazard, need, capacity.
School marked "verify locally".
No resident's location on the map.
narration_fil: Nilagyan ng BHW ng tatlong layer ang map at minarkahang “kailangang kumpirmahin” ang paaralan. Hindi niya ibinahagi ang lokasyon ng partikular na residente.
narration_en: The BHW adds three map layers and marks the school “verify locally.” They do not share an identifiable resident’s location.

display_fil:
Hindi opisyal na hazard map.
Hindi evacuation order.
Igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
display_en:
Not an official hazard map.
Not an evacuation order.
Protect household privacy.
narration_fil: Ang mapa ng pagsasanay ay hindi opisyal na hazard map o evacuation order. Gamitin ang opisyal na pagtatasa at igalang ang privacy ng sambahayan.
narration_en: The practice map is not an official hazard map or evacuation order. Use official assessments and protect household privacy.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Tapos na ang mapa ng pagsasanay. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: The practice map is done. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Sabihing bukas ang paaralan kahit hindi pa nasuri ng sinuman.
options.en: Say the school is open without checking with anyone.

options.fil: Ipasuri sa DRRM office at health team ang mapa bago gamitin.
options.en: Ask the DRRM office and health team to verify the map before use.

options.fil: Ipaskil ang mapa ng pagsasanay bilang opisyal na evacuation order ng barangay.
options.en: Post the practice map as the barangay's official evacuation order.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi pa kumpirmado ang paaralan. 2: Beripikadong mapa lang ang dapat gumabay sa tao; itala kung sino at kailan nagpatunay. 3: Hindi opisyal na hazard map o evacuation order ang mapa ng pagsasanay.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: the school is still not confirmed. 2: Only a verified map should guide people; record who verified it and when. 3: The practice map is not an official hazard map or evacuation order.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipasuri ang blankong risk-map checklist sa barangay DRRM focal person; itala kung kailan ito huling in-update.
narration_en: On Monday, have the barangay DRRM focal person review a blank risk-map checklist and record its last update.
